default_memory_runtime: Android-native in APK; no Python/PC/ADB required
instrumentation_apk: Device harness not executed; this release uses JVM Android 14 framework validation
model_tests: Controlled payload capture confirms archived sources beyond 160 turns, date isolation, display-state exclusion and one answer-model call; real cloud summaries not evaluated
model_setup: Official DeepSeek V4.1 Flash preset; one key field, official links, test-before-save, failure isolation, provider key isolation, cancellation and timeout guards; controlled model only
model_balance: Official GET /user/balance; total/top-up/granted by currency, timestamped cache, manual refresh, strict credential origin, failed query means unknown; controlled fixture tests
conversation: Paged archive separate from 160-turn model state; millisecond send/completion/segment-display timestamps and zones; lossless local 1-3 part presentation, cancellation, unseen-content context exclusion and deletion tombstones
history_recall: Explicit dated questions automatically read local recent and archived transcripts; bounded dated evidence reaches the current answer model; no extra recall model or Python service
